description: Snapshot/capture reproduction of the common workspace frame (screen-snapshot-scrm Phase 2H, Req 30). Add box-drawing content-grid rendering to the ff-screen-model text + html renderers, and CREATE the shared common-frame chrome helper in ff-desktop that composes the eight frame elements (window title bar, menu bar, FULL tab bar, centered title, Command ===> line, Message_Line when present, common+per-Kind Status_Bar with no RUNNING, pfshow key bar) onto every capturable Context's ScreenModel from live logical state. SNAPSHOT and CAPTURE share the one seam. DEPENDS ON FEAT-001 (message_line + last_action_at + status helpers). TDD-first. NOTE: Phase 2G's shared chrome helper is NOT present on this branch, so this FEAT builds it, scoped to exactly the common-frame elements Req 30 requires (do not re-litigate all of Req 29).
steps: Read context.json FIRST and FEAT-001.findings for the implemented names. Work inside the worktree.

2H.5 (Req 30.12,30.13,30.14): Read crates/ff-screen-model/src/render/text.rs and render/html.rs BEFORE editing. Write FAILING unit tests in each renderer's test module: the text renderer emits a box-drawn grid for model.tables (header rule, header/data separator rule, box-drawing vertical cell separators via the existing Glyphs struct, bottom rule) preserving the [value v]/[ v]/____/padded-value cell conventions and full-frame width, with the ASCII + - | fallback when RenderOptions.unicode_box is false; the html renderer emits <td> cells carrying [value v] and ____. Then implement to pass. Keep each file under 400 non-test lines (split if needed).

2H.1-2H.4 helper (Req 30.1-30.11,30.15-30.17): Write FAILING ff-desktop unit tests for a shared apply_common_frame helper: composes header_lines = Window_Title_Bar ('FileForge Workbench' from the ONE shared title const in main.rs/screen_snapshot.rs + ASCII '_ [] X'), Menu_Bar (live menu echo e.g. 'Settings | Help | SCRM'), FULL Tab_Bar (ALL open TabManager tabs with their [XXX] BuiltinKind::default_title() tags + an ASCII 'x' close marker -- NOT active-tag-only); status_bar.text = 'Last: HH:MM | Prof: <name> | Ln n, Col n | <encoding> | <lines>' plus the active Kind's workspace_status_segment and NO RUNNING; the Message_Line lines from the shell message_line state (above the status bar, OMITTED when empty); the pfshow key-bar line in footer_lines only when key_bar_visible. Then create crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/common_frame.rs with apply_common_frame(&self, model: &mut ScreenModel), register mod common_frame in shell/mod.rs, and make the tests pass.

Wire the helper into the single seam (Req 30.15,30.16): in shell/screen_provider.rs::active_screen_capture, after building each per-Context model, call self.apply_common_frame(&mut model) so EVERY ScreenCapture::Model is framed and SNAPSHOT + CAPTURE share it. Reconcile the KindTag::MenuWorkspace arm so the menu path is not double-framed (it already composes its own two-column body + top command line + PF footer; add only the shared title/menu/tab/status/message chrome, not a second command line or PF footer). Keep menu_workspace_dispatches_to_provider green.

Ensure the in-frame window-title text mirrors the ONE live title constant 'FileForge Workbench' from main.rs (brand token, untranslated). If main.rs's constant is not already pub, add a single shared pub const (in screen_snapshot.rs or main.rs) and reference it from both; do NOT hardcode a second copy.

2H.6 (Req 30.1,30.3,30.4,30.10,30.12,30.15,30.16): Write full-shell egui_kittest tests in a new crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/tests_common_frame_snapshot.rs (mirror tests_config_snapshot_fidelity.rs harness usage): (a) a SNAPSHOT over the live ALIAS Editor (table Context) with a SECOND tab open contains the menu-bar line, BOTH tab tags (e.g. [ALIASES] and [CONFIG]), the box-drawing grid, the Last:/Prof: status segments, and no RUNNING; (b) a SNAPSHOT over the live CONFIG panel (markdown_sections Context) contains the menu-bar line, the [CONFIG] tag, the Command ===> line, the status segments, and no RUNNING (GENERAL, not Alias-specific); (c) a capture-path parity test: the CAPTURE seam yields the IDENTICAL reproduced frame text as the SNAPSHOT seam for the same Context.

COMPILE-VERIFY only: SCOPED cargo check/clippy/fmt for BOTH ff-screen-model and ff-desktop, plus the SCOPED new tests (cargo test -p ff-screen-model box_draw; cargo test -p ff-desktop common_frame_helper; cargo test -p ff-desktop common_frame_snapshot). Read the output. Do NOT run the full suite. Commit locally; do not push.
Set this FEAT status to completed; record in findings the exact helper name (apply_common_frame), its file, and the seam wiring, for FEAT-003 to cite.
acceptance_criteria: The ff-screen-model text renderer emits a box-drawing content grid for model.tables (ruled borders + vertical cell separators) preserving [value v]/[ v]/____/padded cells and full-frame width, with the ASCII + - | fallback when unicode_box is false; the html renderer carries [value v] and ____ in <td> cells.

A shared apply_common_frame helper (crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/common_frame.rs) composes the eight frame elements from live logical state (never egui): window title bar, menu bar, FULL tab bar (all tags + close marker), centered title, Command ===> line, Message_Line when present (omitted when empty), common+per-Kind Status_Bar with no RUNNING, pfshow key bar.
The helper is called once in active_screen_capture so SNAPSHOT and CAPTURE share it; the menu/POM path is reconciled without double-framing.
The in-frame window title mirrors the single live 'FileForge Workbench' constant (no duplicate hardcoded copy).
Full-shell snapshot tests prove the frame is GENERAL across a table Context (Alias) and a markdown_sections Context (Config), and capture matches snapshot byte-for-byte.
No public ff-screen-model / ff-scrm type reshaped (Req 30.17). Every new test carries a // Validates: Requirement 30.x annotation.
findings:
DONE on branch common-frame-impl. All scoped checks clean (logs under _ignore/logs/): ff-screen-model -- cargo check --tests (rc 0), cargo test box_draw (4 pass), cargo test html_table_cells (1 pass), full crate suite (49 lib + 1 property pass, no regressions), clippy --tests -D warnings (rc 0), fmt --check (rc 0). ff-desktop -- cargo check --tests (rc 0), cargo test common_frame_helper (6 pass), common_frame_snapshot (3 pass), screen_provider (3 pass), snapshot (48 pass incl config fidelity / editor tables / scrm / nav / dual-flavor), common_frame (12 pass incl FEAT-001's 3), clippy --tests -D warnings (rc 0), fmt --check (rc 0).

EXACT IMPLEMENTED CODE NAMES (FEAT-003 cite these):

SHARED CHROME HELPER (NEW FILE crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/common_frame.rs, registered as `mod common_frame;` in shell/mod.rs between `reset_bare` and `screen_provider`):
  - `impl WorkbenchShell { pub(super) fn apply_common_frame(&self, model: &mut ff_screen_model::ScreenModel) }` -- THE shared common-frame composer. Prepends header_lines = [window-title bar, menu-bar echo, FULL tab bar], sets status_bar.text (shared + per-Kind, NO RUNNING), pushes self.message_line into model.messages (omitted when empty), and appends the pfshow key-bar line to footer_lines ONLY when key_bar_visible AND the active tab is NOT KindTag::MenuWorkspace (the menu/POM body folds its own PF footer -- no double-frame, Req 30.15/30.16). Never adds a title or command line (title stays in model.title; the Command ===> line stays as each per-Context builder set it / the menu builder folds into body_lines).
  - Private helpers on the same impl: `common_frame_window_title_line(&self)` ('<WINDOW_TITLE>    _ [] X'), `common_frame_menu_bar_line(&self)` (bar-visible resolve_menu_bar_menu() options' .command joined by ' | '), `common_frame_tab_bar_line(&self)` (EVERY tab's BuiltinKind::from_tab_kind(..).default_title() [XXX] tag + ASCII 'x' close marker; the active tab wrapped '>TAG x<'), `common_frame_status_bar_text(&self)` ('Last: HH:MM | Prof: <name> | Ln n, Col n | <encoding> | Lines n' + non-empty workspace_status_segment()).
  - Module consts in common_frame.rs: `WINDOW_CONTROLS = "_ [] X"`, `TAB_CLOSE_MARKER = "x"`.

SHARED TITLE CONST (crates/ff-desktop/src/screen_snapshot.rs): `pub const WINDOW_TITLE: &str = "FileForge Workbench"` -- the ONE live title. main.rs now references `screen_snapshot::WINDOW_TITLE` for BOTH the eframe viewport title and run_native app id (the two former hardcoded copies removed). common_frame.rs references the same const for the in-frame window-title bar.

SEAM WIRING (crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/screen_provider.rs):
  - `active_screen_capture(&self) -> ScreenCapture` is now a THIN wrapper: it calls the NEW private `active_context_capture(&self) -> ScreenCapture` (the former per-Context KindTag dispatch + dialog-overlay short-circuit, moved verbatim) then, for a `ScreenCapture::Model`, calls `self.apply_common_frame(model)`. So SNAPSHOT + CAPTURE share the ONE frame. A dialog-overlay capture and an OptOut are returned UNFRAMED (frontmost transient surface / not capturable).
  - `menu_workspace_dispatches_to_provider` stays green (the menu model keeps its body_lines; the helper only adds shared chrome, not a 2nd command line or PF footer).

ff-screen-model RENDERER CHANGES:
  - render/text.rs: tables now render as a BOX-DRAWING GRID via new private fns `render_table_grid(out, table, &Glyphs)`, `push_grid_rule(out, &widths, &Glyphs, GridRule)` (enum GridRule { Top, Mid, Bottom }), `push_grid_row(out, &cells, &widths, &Glyphs)`. Grids are emitted BELOW the main frame (like command_line/status_bar sit outside it) so their ruled borders/vertical separators use pure box glyphs (Unicode) or the +/-/| ASCII fallback (unicode_box=false). Fixed per-column widths = max(header, all data cells) so an overflowing cell WIDENS its column (Req 30.14). Cell conventions [value v]/[ v]/____/padded are drawn verbatim. The prior inside-frame row.join("  ") table path was REMOVED.
  - render/html.rs: UNCHANGED behaviour -- <td> cells already carry each cell verbatim (escaped); added a test proving [value v]/[ v]/____ pass through.
  - No public ff-screen-model / ff-scrm type reshaped (Req 30.17). ScreenModel slots (header_lines/body_lines/footer_lines/tables/status_bar/messages/command_line) used as-is.

FEAT-001 NAMES CITED (used, not re-invented): message_line (Vec<String>), last_action_at, format_last_action (-> 'Last: HH:MM' / 'Last: --:--'), active_profile_label (-> 'Prof: <name>'), workspace_status_segment (per-Kind tail, empty default), note_action_dispatched.
